headline: Anniversary Hill maintenance, a special permit, C.P.A. and CDBG projects, and No Trespassing signs.
summary: The agenda lists maintenance options for Anniversary Hill and a special permit discussion. It also covers C.P.A. projects, CDBG projects, and No Trespassing signs, plus a Mayor Memo.
